findings: profile contains dependencies and order only as descriptive text
no required dependency content kind or graph contract exists
interpretations: dependency semantics are currently not machine-enforced

findings: manager has no Work Package command or package schema
execution state is owned per individual Work Unit
interpretations: multi-unit scheduling requires a separate package-level owner while retaining per-unit execution state

findings: the only current batch operation is cleanup-completed
no topological ordering, cycle rejection, parallel launch limit or aggregate package result test exists
interpretations: requested behavior is a new orchestration capability rather than an extension of cleanup batching

content.question: Work Package의 병렬·순차 실행 모델을 무엇으로 정할까요?

choices.A: DAG 기반: prerequisite를 선언하고 독립 노드는 병렬, 의존 노드는 순차 실행

content.question: Work Unit 오류나 process 종료를 package에서 어떻게 처리할까요?
content.answer: 전체 DAG 사전 감지를 통과한 뒤 ACK한 실행은 blocked 또는 failed로 끝내지 않는다. 오류는 내부 복구하고 의도치 않은 process 종료는 main agent가 같은 package exec를 다시 실행해 durable state에서 완료까지 이어간다.

findings: launcher process remained silent on stdout until terminal completion
main had to poll canonical Work Unit progress to confirm running state
terminal receipt reported 2187 seconds and zero recoveries
interpretations: package exec requires an immediate machine-readable ACK and subsequent progress events independent of terminal output

content.question: DAG 전체 실행 결과의 Human review와 Git integration 단위를 무엇으로 할까요?
content.decision: Package integration branch에 node 결과를 위상 순서로 합성하고 전체 완료 후 한 번 review 및 target integration한다.
